#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
    }
    std::vector<int> cost;
    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        sum += (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ? -1 : 1;
        if (sum == 0) {
            cost.push_back(std::abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
        }
    }
    std::sort(cost.begin(), cost.end());
    int tcost = 0, maxp = 0;
    for (int c : cost) {
        if (tcost + c <= b) {
            tcost += c;
            ++maxp;
        }
    }
    std::cout << maxp << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
